name: dz-photo
description: DZ-Photo (PhotoCraft Studio / مصمم الصور وتعديلها) — The Algerian Sovereign Web Photo & Graphic Design Studio. Alternative to Adobe Photoshop, Photopea, and Canva. Features multi-layer canvas, Algerian social media & print dimension presets, brushes, filters, color adjustment, shape drawing, and PNG/JPEG/WEBP export. Built to the HeyPuter/everything standard.
author: DZ Open Suite Contributors
